AUTHOR: Lopez-Marcano
TITLE: Automatic detection of fish and tracking of movement for ecology
DATA: Own footage: training videos (May–Sep 2019, six action cameras, 8,700 annotated fish) and a separate movement dataset (Oct 2019, 76 video snippets, 169 bream) from a different location in the estuary
V_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'This environment suffers from frequent low visibility and currents that bring floating debris'; cameras 'deployed at a depth of 2–3 m' — no quantitative visibility or stratified results
D2: 90/10 random train/validation split of annotated frames; separate movement dataset used as test
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'We used a randomly selected 90% sample of the annotated dataset for the training, with the remaining 10% for validation'
R_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'movement data gathered one month after the training dataset was collected from a different location in the Tweed River estuary'; all reported detection/tracking metrics are on this dataset
C_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'We used a confidence threshold of 80%, meaning that we selected object detection outputs where the model was 80% or more confident' — single fixed threshold, no sensitivity analysis
E_EV: Sec. 2.3.3: 'we manually observed all the videos and determined the direction of movement for each fish'; Results 3.1: 'missed 21 bream (false negatives) ... out of the 169 fish (ground-truth)'
ARCH: Mask R-CNN (ResNet50, maskrcnn-benchmark) detector feeding three trackers: MOSSE, Seq-NMS (IoU>=30% linking), SiamMask
METR: mAP50, precision/recall/F1 for detection (per individual fish) and for tracking; proportion of movement directions vs ground truth
NOTE: Train/validation split is random at frame level (D1 coded accordingly, D_ALL = N mechanically), but the evaluation ('movement') dataset is a separate deployment at a different location one month later, so test leakage from training frames is unlikely; verifier may consider D1 = 사이트/서식지. R2 = 복수 (different location + different month within the same estuary). E1 = 복수: movement direction/behaviour plus individual counts (169 ground-truth bream) compared with manual reading of the same videos. V2 = Y assumes V2 denotes depth (2–3 m stated). C4 = Y assumes C4 means false positives are discussed (Table 1/2 FP counts, misidentified algae/other fish); fixed 0.8 confidence threshold with no sensitivity analysis so C_ALL = N. Paper notes 'the array also resulted in repeated tracking of fish' but does not handle duplicates (C5 = 없음). Pretraining not stated in text.
